package.json.name: split-bill
package.json.description: Splits a bill between people, to the cent.

setup.CHANGELOG.md:
# Changelog

## 1.3.0

- Adds an optional tip, as a whole percentage.

## 1.2.0

- Refuses fractions of a cent.

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
